trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Large number of probability categories, e.g., 1,000,000, with many samples
trigger_condition.value_trigger: Uniform or near-uniform probabilities with replacement=True
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Stochastic sampling with replacement and large sample count
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Call torch.multinomial on a CUDA tensor with a large number of uniform categories, replacement=True, and many samples; CPU reference with identical probabilities is expected to produce near-uniform counts while CUDA may sample only a small biased subset.

bug_oracle.description: CUDA sampling produces only a small biased subset while CPU produces near-uniform counts for a large uniform categorical distribution.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary category count, sample count, probability distribution shape, dtype, and device; include large uniform distributions.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Build probability tensors on CPU and CUDA with identical values; normalize to valid multinomial probabilities.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Use replacement=True; force CUDA execution; compare against CPU or analytic expectation.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Run torch.multinomial on CPU and CUDA with identical probabilities and sample counts; collect sampled category counts and unique categories.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare sampled category counts and unique category coverage between CPU and CUDA; trigger if CUDA distribution significantly deviates from CPU/statistical expectation, such as many categories never being sampled.
